summary: Reduce API memory retained after large responses.

evidence: Authorized production resource investigation. Independent review of frozen commit 2dedbaa1c found no remaining actionable issues. 29 focused startup/harness tests, the live agent-runtime boundary, and API type/lint checks passed. Controlled response-burst comparisons verified unchanged response bytes and similar CPU cost. This is a bounded allocator-retention repair: smaller-response absolute quiet memory can be slightly higher, and a restored fully warmed production baseline is not claimed. Existing standard Docker/Kubernetes commands require no operator configuration changes.
